Equipment Room

Open aisle

Click or tap the end of any carriage to crank open the aisle on that side, or use the buttons at the top. Click the roll-top shutter above the drawer bank to open or close it. Face view shows either wall of the open aisle straight on: scroll to zoom, drag to pan, arrow keys to switch walls, Esc for 3D.

Look

Photos uses your pictures: each player's cubby from the cubby-wall mockups, the roll-top and carpet from the drawer-bank photo. Plain 3D shows the gear at the sizes in the fit check.

End panel logo

"Centred" spreads one graphic across the whole run of carriages, so it reads as one logo when they're closed and splits when an aisle opens. A full panel graphic (logo on red with stripes) or a transparent PNG both work. The file stays in your browser and is never uploaded.

Camera

Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag or two-finger drag to pan.

Cubby wall length

HBI hasn't confirmed carriage length. With 5 sections, each wall keeps 3 open cubbies for call-ups and trades.
